children: According to Sina Finance, Russian presidential press secretary Dmitry Peskov said on August 29 that there is currently no basis for improving Russia-EU relations. He said European politicians remain confrontational toward Russia in both words and actions, while reiterating that Russia remains open to dialogue.

title: Peskov Says There Is No Basis for Improving Russia-EU Relations
